name: aside
description: Ask Claude for advice in a side pane without touching the session's context: any model, optional read-only tools, an ongoing side thread, cache-aware cost warnings, and a hand-off when an answer is worth keeping.

model.title: Default model
model.description: Who answers an aside. session: the session's own model, reading the session's prompt cache.

tools.title: Read-only tools by default
tools.description: Let an aside read files, search and run read-only commands before it answers.

confirmSwitch.title: Confirm a pricier model
confirmSwitch.description: Hold a question and ask first when the model you picked would cost more than the session's own model reading its cache.

cacheTtl.title: Session prompt-cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long the session's prompt cache lives. auto reads it from the transcript's last cache write, or learns it from asides when the transcript is too big to read.

transcriptTokens.title: Conversation sent to another model, in tokens
transcriptTokens.description: The most of the conversation, newest first, that an aside on another model reads.

threadTurns.title: Earlier asides each question carries
threadTurns.description: How many earlier questions and answers of the side thread a new question carries.
